info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Internal Bank Account API
info.description: The Update Internal Bank Account API enables authorized users to modify existing internal bank account details within the operational services framework. This operation is essential for financial institutions and companies managing various banking accounts, allowing updates to attributes such as account status, limits, and properties. Developers integrating this API will typically include functionalities for account management in their applications, ensuring up-to-date account information aligns with business needs. This API streamlines the process of account modification, contributing to more efficient operational workflows.

requestBody.description: This request body represents the data required to update the internal bank account identified by the provided account number. The fields within the request body should reflect the modifications needed for the specified account.
